messages:
lara_cs: FYI — weekly health thread for 3 accounts where we're planning limit adjustments this Friday. wanted to align on customer comms and the rollback plan.

deepak_csm: which accounts? any that are still in onboarding?

lara_cs: OptimaHealth (in pilot, heavy spikes, close to burst cap), BeaconRetail (production, predictable daily), and NovaAI (onboarding nearly complete, cost concerns).

angela_eng: ops note: the change is a 20% rate-cap increase for OptimaHealth and a soft cap enforcement for BeaconRetail. NovaAI we want to move from 10rps -> 15rps but keep watchdog alerts.

lar a_cs: tagging @simon_prod — can we do a short banner in Console for customers being adjusted? we want to avoid surprise.

simon_prod: yes — we can push a “limits changing” notice that links to the FAQ. i'll need copy and target list by EOD today.

l ara_cs: draft copy below — please critique:
```
Heads up: On 2026-03-27 we will adjust rate limits for some customers to improve overall reliability. If you rely on steady throughput please contact your CSM. No action is required for most customers. See full details: <link>
```

angela_eng: looks fine. add note about rollback and contact if latency increases.

deepak_csm: i'll segment recipients — OptimaHealth and NovaAI get a personal 1:1 email + scheduled call, BeaconRetail gets an automated notice + CSM follow-up.

lara_cs: timeline:
- Today: finalize recipient lists + copy
- Tomorrow morning: simon deploys Console banner + automated notice
- Friday 02:00 UTC: apply limit changes (non-peak window)
- Friday 03:30 UTC: monitor 2h + rollback if error rate > 3x baseline or latency 2x baseline

tim_support: i'll prepare a playbook for support with triage steps and an internal escalation channel. will include a quick-run checklist and expected log snippets.

angela_eng: also adding an automatic fallback to the previous limit variant for OptimaHealth if we see >1% 5xx over 15m.

lara_cs: approve? need ack from all before EOD so simon can schedule.

simon_prod: ack from product. i'll schedule banner today and set the automation for BeaconRetail.

deepak_csm: ack. i'll queue the 1:1 invites.

angela_eng: ack from eng. ops-bot: create incident channel when change starts.

ops-bot: incident channel #ops/limit-adjust-1790234567 created and pinned with runbook."
